# Network 360 Release

January 6, 2026

The production release took place after 2:00 p.m. CDT, 01/06/2026.

# Network360 Core Team

This Network360 release includes the streamlined Adequacy with the Certificate of Need bonus feature, an enhancement for Rank Networks, and bulk add/Inactivate Network360 users, along with some fixes, including security fixes. 

# Enhancements

### Adequacy

The Adequacy feature is now streamlined and easier to use.  The criteria page’s UI is also updated to by utilizing Zelis design elements. 

*  Users will no longer need to use a population file as the geography criteria.  Instead, the user can select up to 5 counties or states that exist within the project’s geography. 
* There will be only two choices of Medicare Advantage specifications to be used as the standards for determining adequacy. Previously the category for these specifications was referred to as “Global;” now, the category is “Medicare Advantage.” 
* The reference network is now referred to as the comparison network.  This enables the terminology to be more consistent across Network360. 
* The default access methodology is standard.  Note in the screenshot above the Access Methodology selection appears because the client has the Compound Access Methodology permission enabled.  Without this permission, the user will not see this information within the Adequacy feature. 
* On the Analysis Results page, when the user wants to view a subset of the analysis criteria’s geography, the user should select their desired geographies in the “Show results for” field.  
* Now, the Certificate of Need (CON) bonus is automatically applied so that Adequacy analysis results will reflect regulatory requirements accurately without manual intervention.  This will display in a similar manner to the telehealth bonus.

### Administration

Now on the Administration > Permissions tab, a client’s feature permissions include Custom Specifications and Custom Access Methodology.  Without these selected, the user’s experience in the Adequacy feature will be further streamlined.  However, when a client has the Accessibility feature enabled, the Custom Specification and Custom Access methodology are automatically selected. 

### Bulk Add/Deactivate Users

Now, internal admin users can add new users or deactivate existing users in bulk for a client by uploading a file and selecting the desired bulk action.   With this enhancement, these user updates will no longer be dependent on the development team’s schedule. 



### Rank Networks

Users can easily understand drug networks and tier coverage with this new enhancement.  When a project has drug data, the user and survey recipients can add drug information into a ranking.  When viewing the Selected Drugs tab, the drug name and coverage information will display in a clear understandable design.

When “View Networks” appears within the ranking, the coverage column displays a summary noting the number of networks in the ranking in which the drug is covered.  When the user clicks “View Networks”, the tier information will display in the Coverage column.  Both the Network and Coverage columns can be filtered.  

 

### Manage Specifications

The previous specification category name “Global” has been replaced with “Medicare Advantage.”



# Fixes

### Create a List

Fixed an issue where a Provider List export with a very large, selected geography timed out during the calculation of the Market Total.  Now, the export successfully runs without the market total calculation in this type of instance. 

### Competitive Dashboard

Now, when the user is on the results page and clicks on the breadcrumbs, no error appears and the user is able to navigate to the expected page.

### Cost Impact

Fixed an error that appeared when a Cost Impact analysis was performed.  The error no longer appears.

### Recruitment

Fixed an issue where the Details Results page timed out and did not load as expected.  Now, the page loads and the results are displayed.

### Provider Profile

Fixed an issue where the wrong group name was associated with a facility provider’s address. 

### Model Networks

Now when a model network is created manually without utilizing the description field, the model is created successfully.  Previously, an error message appeared.
